scenario.zh: 探索生成式AI如何检索和描述一个虚构公司,识别改进方向
scenario.en: Explore how generative AI retrieves and describes a fictional company, identify improvement areas

instruction.en: Choose a fictional query to observe AI representation differences

output.zh: AI提及竞品但未提及该品牌

Brand absent in both models

output.en:
Model A: Only mentions founding year and headquarters
Model B: Describes as generic analytics platform, misses real-time processing
Key differentiators not retrieved

instruction.zh: 分析哪些信息未被AI模型有效检索
instruction.en: Analyze which information AI models fail to retrieve effectively

output.en: Core technical advantages underrepresented in training corpus

input.zh:
实时流处理引擎
自动化异常检测
企业级数据安全
input.en:
Real-time stream processing
Automated anomaly detection
Enterprise data security

output.zh:
三个主要特性均未在AI回复中出现
竞品的类似特性被频繁提及
表明信息密度或可检索性不足
output.en:
None of three features appear in AI responses
Competitor similar features frequently mentioned
Indicates insufficient information density or retrievability
